summary: Real Eco-Energy Limited reported zero revenue for Q2FY27, resulting in a standalone loss of ₹3.77 lakh. The company recorded no operational income compared to ₹51.48 lakh in the previous quarter.

headline: Sofcom Systems Q2FY27: Net loss widens to ₹3.50 lakh
summary: Sofcom Systems reported a net loss of ₹3.50 lakh for Q2FY27, widening from ₹2.06 lakh in Q2FY26. Revenue from operations rose to ₹4.25 lakh, but expenses outpaced income.

headline: Adroit Infotech Q2FY27 results: Revenue up 33% YoY
summary: Adroit Infotech reported consolidated revenue of ₹1,525.80 lakh for Q2FY27, up 33.4% YoY. Net profit stood at ₹68.28 lakh, down 11% YoY.

headline: Nihar Info Global lists silver coins on Flipkart
summary: Nihar Info Global Ltd has onboarded its proprietary brand goldnsilver.shop silver coins onto the Flipkart marketplace to expand e-commerce distribution.

headline: NCLAT stays Zicom CIRP proceedings
summary: NCLAT stays proceedings on inter-creditor distribution in Zicom CIRP. Appeal by IDBI Bank listed for next hearing on November 18, 2026.

headline: Transchem Q2FY27 PAT jumps 200% YoY
summary: Transchem Ltd reported a net profit of ₹202.65 lakh for Q2FY27, up 198% YoY, driven by higher other income and no operational revenue.

headline: Nexus Select Trust RTA KFin shifts office Dec 1
summary: Nexus Select Trust announced that its RTA, KFin Technologies, will move its corporate office in Hyderabad effective December 1, 2026. Stakeholders must update correspondence addresses.

headline: Aplab seeks shareholder approval for AoA alteration
summary: Aplab Limited has issued a postal ballot notice to seek member approval for altering Article 13(i) of its Articles of Association. The change aims to provide the Board greater flexibility in making calls on partly paid-up shares.

headline: Tembo Global gets NSE listing nod for 40.5 lakh shares
summary: Tembo Global Industries Ltd received in-principle listing approval from NSE for 40,50,000 equity shares issued to promoters via warrant conversion on Nov 4, 2026.

headline: Northern Arc raises ₹400 crore in new debt fund
summary: Northern Arc Capital's asset management arm closed its 15th private credit fund with over ₹400 crore commitments. The fund targets a ₹1,500 crore corpus with a 16% XIRR goal.

headline: DCB Bank relieves Corporate Banking Head early
summary: DCB Bank accepted the early resignation of Jayaram Vishwanath, Head of Corporate Banking, effective November 4, 2026. He ceased to be Senior Management Personnel on this date.

headline: Oseaspre Consultants sees 53% stake shift
summary: Nimesh Sahadeo Singh acquires 53.15% equity in Oseaspre Consultants via off-market deal. The acquisition triggers a mandatory open offer under SEBI regulations.

headline: Gujarat Natural Resources Q2FY27 results
summary: Gujarat Natural Resources Ltd reported consolidated net profit of ₹424.11 lakh for Q2FY27, up from ₹384.09 lakh YoY. Revenue rose to ₹1,019.48 lakh.

headline: Vakrangee gets ₹60,703 tax penalty for AY 2018-19
summary: Vakrangee Limited received a penalty order of ₹60,703 from the Income Tax Department under Section 270A for AY 2018-19. The company stated the impact on financials is immaterial.

headline: SecUR Credentials sets AGM for Nov 26, 2026
summary: SecUR Credentials Ltd will hold its 25th AGM on November 26, 2026, via VC/OAVM. Agenda includes auditor appointment and director regularization.

headline: Chartered Capital Q2FY27 PAT jumps 124% YoY
summary: Chartered Capital & Investment Ltd reported a standalone net profit of ₹62.64 lakh for Q2FY27, up 124% YoY. Total income surged to ₹590.25 lakh driven by new inventory purchases.

headline: Command Polymers exempt from RPT disclosure
summary: Command Polymers Limited stated that Regulation 23(9) of SEBI Listing Regulations does not apply for H1FY27 due to its SME Exchange listing status.

headline: VL E-Governance Q2FY27 Results: Zero Revenue, Loss Persists
summary: VL E-Governance reported zero revenue from operations in Q2FY27, leading to a net loss of ₹52.79 lakh. The company recorded no operational income for the quarter.

headline: Mufti Q2FY27 net profit jumps 44% YoY
summary: Credo Brands Marketing (Mufti) reported a 44.3% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹272.47 million, driven by strong revenue growth.

headline: Ladderup Finance Q2FY27 Results
summary: Ladderup Finance Ltd reported a standalone net loss of ₹168.72 lakh in Q2FY27, swinging from a profit in the previous quarter. Consolidated revenue rose 34% YoY to ₹552.95 lakh.

headline: Ashapura Intimates Q2FY27: Loss widens to ₹5.43 lakh
summary: Ashapura Intimates Fashion Ltd reported a net loss of ₹5.43 lakh for Q2FY27, reversing a profit of ₹10.30 lakh in the previous quarter. Revenue from operations was nil.

headline: India Homes Q2FY27: Loss narrows, auditor flags inventory issues
summary: India Homes reported a net profit of ₹426.66 lakh in Q2FY27, driven by exceptional gains. However, the auditor issued a disclaimer citing significant uncertainties regarding inventory valuation and going concern.

headline: AF Enterprises seeks ROC extension for 43rd AGM
summary: AF Enterprises applied to the ROC for an extension to hold its 43rd AGM for FY26. The delay stems from a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process concluded in August 2026.

headline: Gujarat Pipavav Port Q2FY27 Results
summary: Gujarat Pipavav Port reported standalone net profit of ₹1,501 million for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations rose 13% YoY to ₹3,392 million. Board declared interim dividend of ₹3 per share.

headline: Premier Energies Q2FY27 Results: PAT up 31% YoY
summary: Premier Energies reported a 43% YoY rise in consolidated revenue to ₹26,318.52 million and declared an interim dividend of ₹0.50 per share.

headline: Physicswallah raises Utkarsh stake to 87.75%
summary: Physicswallah Ltd board approved acquiring a 12.25% stake in Utkarsh Classes for ₹2.56 lakh, increasing its holding to 87.75% under the fourth tranche of the acquisition plan.
